about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: A journey of trust, quality, and community
about.story1: Anchan Garments was established in 1999 on Market Road in Bantwal. With the grace of God, the blessings of our Gurus, and the unwavering support of our valued customers, the business steadily grew to greater heights.
about.story2: Over time, it became widely recognized as a trusted destination for wedding sarees at affordable prices across Bantwal Taluk. In 2007, the store moved into its own building, further strengthening its presence.
about.story3: Continuing this journey, in 2024, we proudly launched Anchan Silks at the Bantwal bypass — a large-format store bringing together an extensive collection under one roof.
about.social1: Since 1999, a portion of our earnings has been dedicated to supporting religious, social, and government educational institutions.
about.social2: We established the Sri Durga Charitable Trust and took leadership in developing Daddala Kadu Government School — the very school where we once studied.
about.social3: With the collective efforts of our team and supporters, the school now provides quality education to over 1,005 children.
about.ownerQuote: We firmly believe that equal education should be accessible to all. We humbly seek the continued love, trust, and support of our cherished customers.
